data.narrative:
Planted Solar is a Series A climate and energy company that has raised $32M to date. The valuation landscape in Climate & Energy includes one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers, though same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the sector proved insufficient in quantity to support a reliable median multiple method. The nearest private peers by sector include Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix, though these operate across varying maturity levels and subsectors.

Given data constraints, stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable approach. Using total capital raised ($32M) as a proxy for pre-money valuation and applying a standard 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A progression yields an implied valuation of $64M. This represents the median point of a triangulated range anchored by this single method.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $54M (low) to $74M (high), centered on $64M. The range reflects ±15% sensitivity around the stage-progression result. Key uncertainties include the absence of granular same-stage climate-tech comparables to validate the 2.0x multiplier assumption and limited visibility into Planted Solar's specific revenue trajectory, unit economics, or differentiation relative to the broader peer set. Validation would benefit from additional near-term milestone data or narrower peer identification within subsector focus areas.
